subject: Annual prepay invoice calendar + drawdown gates for LumenHealth
messages:
From: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@lumenhealth.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@lumenhealth.com
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepay schedule + VAT evidence request

Hi Marcus,

We're finalizing our FY27 budget and want to confirm Redwood's invoicing cadence for our annual committed spend. Can you send a proposed invoice calendar (dates + amounts) and outline how drawdowns will be triggered against our prepaid balance?

Separately, procurement needs VAT/tax evidence for our AP team — specifically a company VAT certificate and an example invoice that shows VAT treatment. Also confirm who to route our PO to and whether we need any special bank remittance reference.

Thanks,
Elena Suarez
Senior Procurement Manager
LumenHealth
billing@lumenhealth.com
(415) 555-0198

[attachment: LumenHealth_PO_sample.pdf (pdf)]

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay schedule + VAT evidence request

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and congrats on locking the FY27 plan. Attached is a draft invoice calendar and a short drawdown runbook:

- Proposed cadence: 3 invoices (initial deposit on 2026-07-15, mid-year tranche on 2026-10-15, final reconciliation invoice on 2027-01-15).
- Milestone triggers: initial invoice = contract signature + PO receipt; mid-year tranche = 50% of committed spend consumed OR automatic 90-day time-based trigger (whichever comes first); reconciliation = end-of-year usage true-up.
- Drawdown mechanics: each API token usage will decrement the prepaid ledger in near-real time; finance will receive a daily consumption CSV and monthly ledger snapshot.

I looped in Kim (tax & billing) and Olga (invoicing ops) for the VAT certificate and remittance details. Please confirm if LumenHealth requires netting or that each ledger drawdown reference includes the PO number.

Attaching: 2026-06-30_Redwood_InvoiceSchedule.xlsx (proposed calendar) and sample invoice.

Next steps: if this aligns, we'll send final invoices and a DocuSign amendment that notes the committed spend and payment terms.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
[attachment: 2026-06-30_Redwood_InvoiceSchedule.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Elena Suarez <elena.suarez@lumenhealth.com>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@lumenhealth.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay schedule + VAT evidence request

Thanks Marcus — that looks sensible. A couple quick clarifications before I route this to AP:

1) VAT: LumenHealth will apply reverse-charge where applicable; we need Redwood's VAT registration number and a certificate indicating VAT applicability in the US (or confirmation of zero-rated if not registered).
2) PO referencing: AP requires the PO number on each invoice line and a single ledger reference for automated reconciliation. Can you include a static remit reference (e.g., LH-PO-<PO#>) in the invoice template?
3) Bank details: please confirm wire routing instructions (bank name, account number, SWIFT/ABA).

If you can turn around responses and the VAT cert by EOD Friday (07/03), we can issue the PO on Monday and get the initial deposit out the following week.

Regards,
Elena

Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepay schedule + VAT evidence request

Hi Elena — looping in Tax ops. Quick answers below:

- VAT registration: Redwood is not VAT-registered in the US; for US-domiciled customers VAT is not charged. We can provide a VAT certificate stating that Redwood is not VAT-registered in the US market and the relevant tax ID for cross-border reporting. Attached: Redwood_VAT_Certificate_US-2026.pdf.
- Reverse charge: if LumenHealth is applying reverse-charge for cross-border subsidiaries, that is for your AP to self-assess. Our invoices will include a note: "Customer to self-assess VAT where applicable" and will include our company tax identifier.
- Remit reference: we can add a static ledger reference field — suggested format LH-PO-<PO#> — and we will bake that into the invoice template.

Olga will confirm bank wiring details and send a payment routing stub.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Manager, Tax & Billing
Redwood Inference
